title: Photographer
summary: Pictures first: a full-width gallery, projects as a grid, then a short bio and a clear way to hire you.

notFor: Videographers whose work lives on a video platform (start from creator)

cards.purpose: Six to twelve of their strongest recent pictures, no frame around them.
Series or commissions, each with a cover picture.
Who they are, who they work for, prints.

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: Which six to twelve pictures best show your work now?
slots.write: The member uploads each picture in the editor. Per picture: alt = what is in it, for someone who cannot see it; caption = place and year, or the title they use. Ask; never guess what a picture shows.

slots.ask: Do you have series or commissions you want to show, each with a cover picture?
slots.write: tag = Series, Long-term series or Commission · client; title = their title; description = one line on what it is about.

slots.ask: Where are you based, what kind of work do you take, and which clients may you name?
slots.write: One short paragraph plus bold-labelled lines, as in the sample. Name only clients they say they may name.

slots.ask: How should people commission you: a booking page, a call, email?
slots.write: Keep the presets (hire, bookCall) that match a URL they give you; publish an email only if they confirm it may be public. The first button is the main one.

slots.ask: Which portfolio sites or social accounts should be linked?
slots.write: The account URL only; the app shows the site and account name itself.
